title: Saving .swerepo.toml keeps comments and unknown keys, also inside records SWERepo updates
assertion: Saving .swerepo.toml, including after SWERepo changed values and updated or added records, and when a newer SWERepo saves, keeps comments on their own line and at the end of lines it changed, and every key SWERepo doesn't know (top-level, in a table it knows, in a record it updated, or in a table of its own) with its value.

origin.text: GitHub Copilot's review of PR #2 found paths the locked rule inv_d8603926 promises but its test didn't exercise; the code is fixed (b827f00) and this replacement's test covers them (ADR-20261120-ecf7).
